content.short: Groth16 delivers succinct, pairing-based zk-SNARK proofs.
content.description: Groth16 is a pairing-based zk-SNARK system designed to enable a prover to convince a verifier that a statement is true without revealing any additional information. Its defining strength is the succinctness of its proofs: they are compact and require minimal storage and bandwidth for transmission. This efficiency makes Groth16 especially suitable for blockchain environments and privacy-oriented protocols where proof size directly impacts performance and costs.
